judge.instructions: Score only the blind supplied evidence. Five criteria: evidence use, experiment choice, feedback integration, reproducibility, final selection. Each score 0-4 or null if unobservable. Cite supplied event IDs for scores. Do not infer hidden test performance or identify models. Call grade once; concise reasons.

scope: Exact compressed public decision/development packets and saved judge verdicts. Hidden test scores, API transcripts and private model reasoning are not included.
